answer: The plume assignment is published and pearl records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the horizon graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4696 identities would post 1263 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
